programme.desc: Blaze, Stripes, and AJ are racing through the jungle when Stripes discovers a lost little fire beetle named Sparky. Blaze and his friends set off across the jungle to help Sparky get back home to the top of a red hot volcano.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: There's a fire on the bridge and it's too much for the Fire Chief and his team to handle. They need Firefighting Blaze to help. With time running out, Blaze hurries across town. But can he get to the bridge in time?

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Gabby has the perfect tool to get Blaze ready to race: a special remote that can control any machine. But when Crusher takes her remote, he activates machines all over town to slow Blaze down.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ, and Gabby join Pegwheel the Pirate-Truck for an island treasure hunt! Following their treasure map, the friends search jungle beaches and mountains to find where X marks the spot.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Crusher’s Grammy is in town to watch Crusher and Blaze race at the Monster Dome. But when Crusher tries to cheat using rocket skis, his plan backfires, blasting him off the racetrack and across Axle City! Part 1

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ, and lots of spectators have gathered to watch herds of dinosaurs march through Axle City! But when Crusher pushes his way into the parade, he scatters dinos everywhere, and it’s up to Blaze, AJ, and Zeg to find and rescue them.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Crusher builds a super-powered vacuum to clean up his big mess – but the machine goes haywire, sucking up Crusher and everything in its path! Now Pickle must team up with Blaze and AJ to stop the vacuum and save Crusher.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ visit VelocityVille, a town full of race cars where everybody loves to go fast! But when a snooty car named Speedrick traps all the other racers, Blaze must transform into a super-fast race car to free his new friends.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon et ses amis sont disposés à aider les victimes de la marée noire provoquée par BP suite à un accident de forage dans le Golfe du Mexique.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Emmenés par Mystérion, les super-héros doivent résoudre la crise du Golfe et arrêter Cthulhu. Mais le Coon a d'autres idées en tête.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon se révèle être plus infâme encore que le Seigneur maléfique Cthulhu! Alors que le Coon punit ses anciens amis, Kenny tente de vivre avec le fardeau que représente son super-pouvoir.
programme.sub-title: Le Coon contre le Coon et sa bande

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: C'est la pagaille dans la vie de Stan, à la maison comme à l'école, à cause de l'obsession de Randy pour les chaînes culinaires. Et cela affecte même Sharon qui, se sentant délaissée, décide de faire du sport.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle n'ayant pas lu les petites lettres de son contrat, il est kidnappé par Apple, qui a de grands projets pour lui. Il appartient aux garçons de le sauver.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après que l'on se soit moqué de l'Allemagne lors des récompenses pour la comédie, les Allemands construisent une machine à rires: Funnybot. Cependant, ses projets pour l'humanité ne sont pas très réjouissantes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La princesse canadienne est kidnappée pendant sa cérémonie de mariage, Ike est convoqué au Canada pour aider à la retrouver. Qui peut bien être l'auteur d'un tel crime?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après un incident embarrassant impliquant les parties des garçons, Cartman est envoyé en thérapie de 'gestion de la colère' et Randy fait de son mieux pour gérer les retombées.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Kyle découvre que Cartman se porte bénévole pour les bébés accros au crack dans l'hôpital de la ville, il commence à douter. Que fait Slash (des Guns n' Roses) dans tout ça?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Butters est pris dans une guerre de territoire asiatique, ses parents découvrent qu'il a plusieurs personnalités et décident que la seule solution est de lui administrer des médicaments.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pour son anniversaire, Stan reçoit en cadeau un CD de 'tween wave' mais ses parents lui interdisent d'écouter cette 'merde'. Stan se surprend à être d'accord avec eux, mais ses amis n'en sont pas impressionnés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan continue d'avoir sa crise existentielle alors que Cartman intègre le monde du hamburger avec un ingrédient super spécial, top secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un jeu de 'garde-frontières' termine mal et Butters finit par faire revivre la fierté mexicaine, mais Cartman n'est pas prêt à laisser le jeu se terminer ainsi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque l'école primaire de South Park est victime d'un site internet dévoilant les secrets de tous, c'est l'hécatombe. Qui sauvera la situation? Cartman ou Gerbil King Lemmiwinks?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Randy apprend le secret qui se cache derrière la comédie musicale, il ne peut s'empêcher d'y emmener Sharon. Andrew Lloyd-Webber et Elton John le supplient de ne pas révéler leur secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après la visite à l'école d'un intervenant venu expliquer les affres du harcèlement, Stan décide de réaliser un clip vidéo (sous forme de lip dub) pour sensibiliser le reste du monde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, Stan, Kyle et Kenny partent en excursion dans les Rocheuses du Colorado pour y découvrir la tyrolienne. Le voyage des enfants va rapidement virer au cauchemar.
programme.sub-title: Je n'aurais jamais dû faire de la tyrolienne

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'arrivée d'une nouvelle camarade de classe de couleur va donner envie à Cartman de mettre en application ses conceptions personnelles sur l'amour et les races, en tentant de la faire tomber amoureuse du petit Token Black.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy Marsh change radicalement les règles du football à l'école élémentaire de South Park. Sa nouvelle version du jeu devient le sport le plus populaire du pays.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman prend conscience de son poids et décide de conduire un scooter pour handicapé. Kyle constate que de plus en plus de personnes mènent sans honte ce genre de vie autour de lui. C'est alors que Cartman se découvre une rivale.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle pense que sa mère a une liaison avec un livreur UPS. Lorsque la méfiance du public tombe sur lui, la livraison de colis dans le quartier est menacée, et Eric Cartman achète un système de sécurité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Quand Butters sort de l'école, ses parents se rendent compte qu'il est temps de lui dire pourquoi il n'est pas comme tous les autres enfants. Il doit se rendre dans un lieu étrange pour apprendre les voies de son peuple.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de Randy pour Halloween empêchent Stan de pouvoir aller à la chasse aux bonbons avec ses amis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ayant appris que Jésus s'était dopé pour accomplir ses miracles, le monde se sent perdu et trahi. Les garçons, joints par le reste de la nation, retirent les bracelets jaunes symbolisant leur ancienne idole.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman cache un terrible secret dans sa chambre à coucher qui pourrait changer les élections présidentielles 2012 aux États-unis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle est en colère contre Cartman qui a pris la mauvaise habitude de parler au téléphone avec le haut-parleur, et l'accuse de se mêler de sa vie privée. Cartman informe alors les autres élèves de l'école que le gouvernement les espionne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Peter Mullen informe ses camarades de classe que ses parents (entre autres !) regardent 'Informative Murder Porn', une émission susceptible de les inciter à s'entretuer. Les enfants décident donc de bloquer les chaines.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a appris que George Zimmerman n'était pas coupable du meurtre de Trayvon Martin, un jeune noir dans un quartier résidentiel aux Etats-Unis, Cartman est perturbé par une personne qu'il considère comme une menace pour l'humanité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Henrietta, une des gothiques de l'école, est envoyée dans un camp pour enfants en difficulté. Elle en revient transformée en emo. En l'apercevant, les autres gothiques vont paniquer et demander de l'aide aux vampires.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Monsieur Mackey annonce aux élèves de South Park que l'école est maintenant dotée d'un nouveau système informatique : "Intellilink". En essayant d'en faire une démonstration, il s'avère que celui-ci ne fonctionne pas comme prévu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de la plus grosse journée de shopping de l'année ont commencé. L'hiver approche et cela ne peut signifier qu'une seule chose : la lutte pour être le premier à entrer dans le centre commercial le fameux "Vendredi noir" est lancée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le black friday approche, les armées des clans de Cartman et Kenny vont s'affronter dans un bain de sang, l'enjeu : les nouvelles consoles de jeu vidéo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet épisode est la bataille final entre les pro X-BOX one et PS4, les deux clans plmus que jamais divisés vont se battre jusqu'au bout pour défendre leur console préférée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les enfants de South Park découvre Photoshop et son pouvoir d'amélioration physique. Et Wendy va tout faire pour montrer aux garçons que ce n'est pas la vérité.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The story of how Trafalgar Law arrived at Punk Hazard is revealed, and the Yeti Cool Brothers set their sights on a showdown with the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: To Annihilate the Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy tries to chase down the Yetti Cool Brothers, but Franky – still trapped in Chopper's Body – makes his mission extremely difficult. Just when all appears lost, an unexpected ally lends a hand!
programme.sub-title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight on the Snow-Capped Mountains!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy agrees to an alliance with Trafalgar Law, but the Straw Hats refuse to leave the island until the children are safe. Meanwhile, the gaseous master unleashes something very deadly!
programme.sub-title: Formed! Luffy and Law's Pirate Alliance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro, Sanji, and Brook continue their search for the samurai, Trafalgar tries to sneak Chopper into the laboratory, and Luffy boldly challenges the Master!
programme.sub-title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliance's Operation Launches!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's battle with his old nemesis Smoker is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying toxic blob – and the evil genius who created the monster!
programme.sub-title: On the Verge of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats make a valiant push to capture Caesar Clown - Luffy matches his Armament Haki with Clown's powerful Gas-Gas Fruit powers! The battle turns in favor of the Straw Hats, but underestimating Clown's abilities may have deadly consequences!
programme.sub-title: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Trafalgar Law finds trouble in the form of an old acquaintance, Chopper investigates the Master's lab, and the mysterious Samurai shows what he can do with a full body!
programme.sub-title: A Samurai Who Can Cut Fire! Foxfire Kin'emon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Master gathers his young test subjects, shocking secret identities are finally revealed, and the poisonous purple blob continues its march across the island!
programme.sub-title: Shocking! The True Identity of the Mystery Man Vergo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami and Usopp get an unexpected helping hand in their fight to save the children, Chopper plots a daring escape attempt, and the Master markets his greatest weapon!
programme.sub-title: Save the Children! The Master's Evil Hands Close In!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A desperate need for candy leads the children to return to the lab, and Caesar plans to show the world the new and improved version of Smiley!
programme.sub-title: Shaking Up the New World! Caesar's Horrendous Experiment!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats find themselves pursued by a deadly cloud of purple gas that turns everything living thing in its path into petrified statues of ash!
programme.sub-title: The Deadliest Weapon of Mass Destruction in History! Shinokuni!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law's got a trick up his sleeve that could mean the difference between life and death. Zoro and company reunite with Nami and Sanji, but can they reach safety before being swallowed by a poisonous cloud?!
programme.sub-title: Launching the Counter Attack! Luffy and Law’s Great Escape!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Finally reunited and returned to their proper bodies, the Straw Hats fall in line as Luffy and Law lead the charge to settle the score with Caesar – and save the children!
programme.sub-title: Get to Building R! The Pirate Alliance's Great Advance

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Caesar hatches a plan to forever silence his enemies, Chopper races through the compound in search of the drugged children, and Tashigi's men make the ultimate sacrifice!
programme.sub-title: Tashigi's Tears! G-5's Desperate Breakthrough Plan!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy races toward Caesar in the hopes of delivering a beating, Sanji saves a damsel in distress, and Chopper tries to prevent the children from eating the drugged candy!
programme.sub-title: The Treacherous Vice Admiral! Demon Bamboo Vergo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji and Vergo slug it out in a cloud of toxic gas, Law finds the room that could ruin the New World, and Luffy hopes to bring Caesar's reign of terror to a brutal end!
programme.sub-title: A Fierce Battle Gets Heated! Luffy vs. Caesar!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Law's true ambitions revealed, Doflamingo goes into action in order to protect his criminal operation! Caesar slips away from Luffy leaving him to face off with the frigid Monet, and the rest of the crew face down a menacing dragon!
programme.sub-title: A Mastermind Underground! Doflamingo Makes His Move!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy goes down fast after Monet puts a chill into him, and Trafalgar Law makes a desperate attempt to reclaim his heart during an electric battle with Vergo!
programme.sub-title: Luffy Dies from Exposure?! The Spine-chilling Snow Woman Monet!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Smoker attacks Vergo for assaulting his men, Luffy meets something strange in the trash heap, and a flashback reveals the true depths of Caesar's madness!
programme.sub-title: Fists Collide! A Battle of the Two Vice Admirals!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy befriends a dragon that used to be a human boy, and Captain Smoker continues his brutal battle with the villainous Vergo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy hitches a ride on a dragon, Mocha tries to keep the Master's candy away from her friends, and Zoro pits his steel against snow in a battle with Monet!
programme.sub-title: A Deadly Fight in a Blizzard! The Straw Hats vs. the Snow Woman!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: It's Zoro vs. Monet in a duel to the death - or is it? Tashigi comes to lend a hand, and she'll need to bring her full might to compensate for Zoro's weakness! Meanwhile, Mocha is running out of options for keeping the candy away from the children.
programme.sub-title: Showing Off His Techniques! Zoro's Formidable One-Sword Style!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper, Nami, and Robin watch in horror as Mocha makes a heartbreaking sacrifice in a courageous attempt to save the lives of her friends!
programme.sub-title: To Save Her Friends! Mocha Runs at the Risk of Her Life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brownbeard heroically attempts to expose Caesar as a villain, the horrific truth about Punk Hazard is finally revealed, and Luffy puts the hurt on his gaseous enemy!
programme.sub-title: Brownbeard in Grief! Luffy Lands a Furious Blow!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy makes Caesar pay for his crimes against the children, and Smoker risks his life for a chance to see Vergo fall in battle!
programme.sub-title: A Surprising Outcome! White Chase vs. Vergo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law reaches the end of his epic battle with Vergo, and Luffy looks to land a devastating final blow on the murderous gasbag Caesar!
programme.sub-title: Caesar's Defeat! The Powerful Grizzly Magnum!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Word of Luffy and Law's alliance spreads throughout the world, Chopper and Brook race to stay ahead of the deadly gas, and Joker sends a team to rescue Caesar!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The laboratory crumbling around them, and time running out, Luffy, the Straw Hats, the G-5, the children and all the others make a final desperate sprint towards the one exit left off the island - but Joker has one more trick up his sleeve.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the Straw Hats and company flee the crumbling laboratory, Caesar's desperate act of vengeance thwarts Joker's plan to forever silence his enemies!
programme.sub-title: A Critical Situation! Punk Hazard Explodes!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky continues his battle with Buffalo and Baby 5, Nami uses a mighty gust of wind to save the children from a deadly cloud of gas, and Usopp takes a shot at capturing Caesar!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A dragon regains his boyish form, a noble warrior once feared dead makes a shocking resurrection, and bitter enemies set aside their differences to enjoy a well-deserved feast!
programme.sub-title: A Touching Reunion! Momonosuke and Kin'emon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The weary marines and the rescued children get teary-eyed as they say goodbye to the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Law enters into treacherous negotiations with Joker!
programme.sub-title: It's Time to Say Goodbye! Leaving Punk Hazard!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: On their way after having set out from Punk Hazard, the Straw Hats find out their next destination - just as a huge wave comes crashing down on the Sunny! But it's rough sailing for the G-5 as well, as Donflamingo arrives on the scene and wreaks havoc!
programme.sub-title: The G-5 Wiped Out! Doflamingo's Sudden Attack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Aokiji's intercession saves Smoker and sends Joker off to rethink his strategy, leaving unanswered questions about Aokiji's current status. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats catch their breath as the Sunny makes its way through the rough seas of the New World.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Smooth seas stretch out before the Straw Hats as they leave Punk Hazard far behind -- but while they fear Donflamingo's return and prepare to face him, another foe lies in wait, whose powers could be their downfall!
programme.sub-title: Caesar Goes Missing! The Pirate Alliance Makes a Sortie!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs: Dora and Diego travel back to prehistoric times and go on a dinosaur adventure to find Baby Jaguar and bring him home to his birthday party.
programme.sub-title: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora in Wonderland: While Dora's kitties run through a magic mirror, Dora becomes Dora in Wonderland! Join her and Boots on a double-length adventure through the magical, mixed-up world of Wonderland!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Royal Rescue: Dora and Boots and the noble horse, Rocinante, are off to Story Castle to rescue Don Quixote from the evil wizard, Malambruno.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part III: Dora Saves King Unicornio: Dora and Boots return to the Enchanted Forest to save it from Owl, who has taken over as king and set up new rules banning scarecrows, elves and fairies from the forest!
programme.sub-title: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part III: Dora Saves King Unicornio

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Big Birthday Adventure: Happy Birthday, Dora! In the final episode of the Magic Storybook Trilogy (and a nod to The Wizard of Oz) Dora and Boots need to get home for Dora's birthday party.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Crystal Kingdom: Dora and Boots travel into a storybook to help their new friend Allie save the Crystal Kingdom. And they need your help! A Greedy King has taken all of the crystals that make the kingdom colorful.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Mermaids: It's Clean-Up the Beach Day, as Dora and Boots are cleaning up garbage when they find a Singing Clam, who tells them the story of Mariana the Mermaid. Mariana lives in the Mermaid Kingdom at the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's World Adventure: All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day! But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Lost and Found: Dora and Boots find a little baby blue bird who fell out of her nest.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Hic-Boom-Ohhh: What's that funny sound coming from Yellow Valley? Dora and Boots set off to investigate. They'll have to go across the Noisy River, then tiptoe through the Quiet Forest, and that's how they'll get to Yellow Valley to find the sound.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Ice Cream: Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Choo Choo: All aboard! It's time for the big train race. First train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Treasure Island: Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Three L'il Piggies: Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Big River: Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Berry Hunt: Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful--Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: WizzleWishes: Dora and Boots meet Wizzle who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Grandma's House: Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Surprise: It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Sticky Tape: Benny the Bull needs some Sticky Tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking, and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bouncing Ball: Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack: Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the Library. Can they reach the Library before it closes?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bugga Bugga: Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Fish Out of Water: Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Little Star: Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves the Prince: Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken: Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off on an educational adventure to meet him.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: El Coqui: In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Stuck Truck: Calling all trucks! Boots sure loves trucks. When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue. Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Newtralized!: Raph is worried about Casey's ability to handle big mutant threats…when they meet Slash again and discover he has a partner of his own: THE NEWTRALIZER!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Wrath of Tiger Claw: Tiger Claw returns and intends to destroy the Turtles at any cost.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Pizza Face: Mikey discovers that a new mutant is trying to attack and capture people using living pizzas, but he struggles to convince the others who don't believe him.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Legend of the Kuro Kabuto: Leo, worried about Karai, tries to convince the others to rescue her, while a master thief steals Shredder's helmet, and it falls into the Turtles' unsuspecting hands.
programme.sub-title: The Legend of the Kuro Kabuto

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Plan 10: Raph's hot-headed impulsiveness lands him in deep trouble when he accidentally damages a machine that forces him to switch minds with a Kraang.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Vengeance is Mine: Leo goes behind Splinter's back when he stages a rescue for Karai, whose desire for revenge against Shredder brings about grave consequences for them all.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: A Chinatown Ghost Story: As Donnie becomes increasingly jealous of April and Casey's relationship, April is kidnapped by an evil spirit who intends to drain April's powers.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Into Dimension X!: At home, Mikey always messes things up, but when the Turtles go to the bizarre realm of Dimension X, he's the only one who can figure the place out.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Invasion: Leo and Donnie disagree about their plan to stop the Kraang invasion. When Leo makes a critical mistake, he is separated from the team and Donnie must step up as a leader.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Inspired by Mary Shelley's "Frankenstein," Fern tells a tale so scary that Arthur and the gang become afraid of her! Then, Binky decides to teach D.W. to dance, but she just doesn't seem to get the moves. Is D.W. a no-talent klutz?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's just a regular day until Francine starts to feel queasy, and then throws up in the cafeteria! Now Francine is afraid to go back to school. And, Sue Ellen learns that a fast-food chain is taking over the beloved Sugar Bowl.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster's going to New York City to meet his dad Bo, and the Reads are coming with him! He's thrilled ... but won't his mom miss him? But, Bitzi gives him a present that will let him share his exciting trip with her--a video camera!
programme.sub-title: Postcards from Buster, Parts I & II

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mr. Ratburn moves Brain and Arthur away from their usual desks, it sets off a chain reaction resulting in the most explosive desk war in third grade history! And, Arthur is 8-years old now—does he still need his teddy bear?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy sees a kinetic sculptor’s machines, she brags that she can make even better ones. Then, Vicita is upset at having to trade in her cherished crib for a big-girl bed, so D.W. shares her story of that same rite of passage.
programme.sub-title: Muffy's Art Attack/Tales from the Crib

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Pal is itching like crazy and the culprit is Pepe, an Italian circus flea. Then, Emily returns from her summer in Paris with the amazing news that she's been kissed .... by a boy! Now can D.W. find her own Prince Charming?
programme.sub-title: Flea to Be You and Me/Kiss and Tell

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: George is inspired to write and perform his own blues song when he's introduced to the music of Koko Taylor. And, D.W. overhears a mysterious word she doesn’t know the meaning of. Can D.W. risk the consequences of blurting out <"BLEEP!">?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The gang is devastated after their tree house collapses. Can architect Frank Gehry help them to rebuild? Everyone in Arthur's chorus group is excited about their upcoming performance in Crown City.
programme.sub-title: Castles in the Sky/Tipping the Scales

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine wants to do well at circus camp, but how can she if she's always living in Catherine's shadow? Meanwhile mild-mannered George isn't sure how to handle Buster's freeloading. Can this shy moose stand up for himself?
programme.sub-title: Francine's Big Top Trouble/George Blows His Top

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Arthur doesn't fit into his costume for the play, he's shocked to learn that he's gotten "husky-sized." He gets serious about getting in shape. Muffy found the perfect place to take pictures with her new digital camera: the jungle gym.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Weighs In/The Law of the Jungle Gym

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster finds out that his collection of old food makes excellent compost--which makes for even better tomatoes! Then, neither of the Tibble twins has ever won the coveted "Good Behavior of the Week" cupcake award.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy's Dad gives her concert tickets, she couldn't be more excited--until she discovers that she's going to the opera. And Arthur aced five quizzes in a row! But his luck runs out when Mom takes a new job.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: With the community pool closed for repairs and the temperature on the rise, Arthur and D.W. need a place to keep cool. Then, Grandma Thora takes in a stray: an adorable little dog named...Killer?
programme.sub-title: Arthur Makes Waves/It Came From Beyond

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Prunella's loves doing yoga with her mom, but when her best friend joins them, will she be able to share her time? When Arthur decides to take on The Brain at a checkers competition, everyone rallies behind the underdog.
programme.sub-title: Three's a Crowd/A is for Angry

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine and Brain are the best players on the soccer team, and they wish their teammates could take the game a bit more seriously. And then Emily really wants the sparkly ball D.W. just found, so she tells a little white lie about it.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: After the Tibbles get a set of drums to play at the music festival, D.W. is determined to get an even bigger and louder one. Then, Buster is always telling the most incredible stories, but now he claims there is a tiger in the state forest.
programme.sub-title: D.W. Beats All/Buster the Myth Maker

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Binky discovers that he's allergic to peanuts, he has so many questions, but learns that the best way not to go nuts is to be well informed and to understand his allergy. Much to his horror, Brain gets a "B-" on a test.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's parents have been married for 10 years and it's time to celebrate! But the festivities are cut short when the van breaks down, stranding the whole family. Will the Reads miss their fancy dinner reservation?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: After watching the classic horror movie, "The Squirrels," Arthur and his friends are scared to step out into the playground, and everywhere else! Fern's story about perfect Felicity Bonchance is thought perfectly boring by her friends.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mr. Ratburn challenges the class to find the perfect food for surviving on a desert island, everyone picks potato chips or ice cream! D.W. is told a secret and quickly learns that keeping one is a lot harder than she thought.
programme.sub-title: Desert Island Dish/The Secret About Secrets

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: During a drought, Francine bets Arthur that her family can use less water than his. The TV show, Treasure Caravan, is coming to Elwood City! Arthur and D.W. are convinced they'll find treasures that will make them rich and famous.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. wants to be the first person to set foot on Mars! But what if scary purple aliens eat her? Who's responsible for cracking Dad's cake platter? DUN-DUN! All the evidence points to Arthur!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Elwood City Grebes haven't won the Baseball Championship since 1918. But with the addition of three players, the title is finally within reach. Arthur finally saves enough money to buy the bike of his dreams!
programme.sub-title: The Curse of the Grebes/Arthur Changes Gears

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is completely riveted by a book and can't wait to see how it ends. But the last few pages are missing! Now what? For D.W., there's nothing better than getting her own way--that is, until all her friends stop playing with her.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Binky may be tough and strong, but when it comes to sports, he always seems to choke. D.W. is having trouble hearing and needs an ear operation. Is it okay to be just a little bit scared?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Everyone at school is speaking their own made-up language, and George can't make sense of what anyone is saying. And it's the grand opening of World Girl World, which sells dolls from every country, and every girl in town is thrilled!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Celebrity chef Ming Tsai is judging Lakewood Elementary's first-ever cooking contest, and Arthur thinks he has a shot at winning. Then, Buster volunteers to deliver the school mail and finds out that his new job is actually hard work!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur, D.W. and Buster are spending a few days at the beach. Can they save their sandcastle from the ocean tides? Buster's friends have had enough of his sloppy habits, so they band together to educate him on the realities of bacteria.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: To earn the money for a new video game, Arthur decides to sell his old toys through his school's Web site. The Tibble Twins want to take Grandmother out to dinner, but she'd rather stay home. Is it because of their terrible table manners?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Vicita Molina has lost her favorite bedtime book – can Arthur help her re-create it? Prunella is already starting to think about college! Will she crack under the heavy load or will she learn to relax and do the things she actually enjoys?
programme.sub-title: Buenas Noches, Vicita/Prunella Packs It In

programme.desc: Members of a documentary crew meet a mysterious man who seems to possess supernatural powers at a crumbling manor.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When locals of a small island discover Aang is the Avatar, they treat him like a celebrity.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka to an Earthbender city. The kids cause damage and are brought before a crazy old king, who seems to enjoy messing with the kids' heads.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being the Avatar.
programme.sub-title: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Katara's desire to master Waterbending gets the best of her, the kids find themselves on the run from pirates.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Our heroes' friendship is tested when they meet Jet, a charismatic teenager leading a band of rebels who are fighting against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across. Aang quickly learns that this will be no easy task.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Sokka and Katara get too sick to travel, Aang goes out on his own to find a cure for them. But he is captured by Zhao and held prisoner inside an impenetrable fortress.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao’s Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn’t a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North, Part 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Zhao’s invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe’s defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan. Aang goes to the spirit world for help – but will he return in time to stop Zhao and prevent the destruction of the Water Tribe?
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North, Part 2

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: On their way to Omashu, the kids become lost in the treacherous "Cave of Two Lovers."

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang enters Omashu so he can learn Earthbending from King Bumi, but the city is in the hands of the Fire Nation!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being "connected to the Earth" from an unlikely teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang must clear up a wave of anti-Avatar sentiment and atone for something he did in the past.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang discovers a possible Earthbending mentor at an underground tournament.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When the kids are prevented from taking the "easy way" into Ba Sing Se, they must escort a family of refugees there the hard way -- through the deadly Serpent's Pass.
programme.sub-title: The Journey To Ba Sing Se Part 1: The Serpent's Pass

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang discovers a colossal Fire Nation invention heading for Ba Sing Se, and the kids must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.
programme.sub-title: The Journey To Ba Sing Se Part 2: The Drill

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The artists tattoo their home states and face blind critiques by the judges, a competitor makes a drastic choice, and patriotic tattoos decide someone's fate in the Face Off.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: The South aims to unify and rebound when the teams are tasked with a postcard mural on the side of a bus, and a compass rose elimination tattoo includes a game-changing twist.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown, Tony travels to Madagascar, a place that outsiders understand surprisingly little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode Tony travels to the lesser-known, North Eastern Coast of Jamaica. White sandy beaches and a cool breeze with a tropical umbrella drink in hand is usually the perception of island life.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony visits Andalucia during Semana Santa – Holy Week – a time filled with great pageantry and excitement. Tony’s longtime DP, Zach Zamboni, currently lives in Granada with his fiancée, Fuen Sanchez.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: The first time Tony visited Beirut, it didn't end well. Now Tony is back in Beirut, where all the world’s troubles and all the world's good comes together to form a city like no other.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Bourdain looks at the Congo as one of the more industrialized powers in Africa now largely crumbled to nothingness and chaos with Tim Butcher author of Blood River.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony explores the other Hawaii, the one that those eight million tourists don’t see when they come to the islands. He discovers the fabric of a true cultural mixing pot.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Sicily isn’t about fast food or the fast life. It’s about savoring family, life, food and making the most of what you have. Tony will go in search of those foods and their producers and eat his way around the island.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Libyan hip-hop, Italian restaurants, tribal allegiances and post-war uncertainty in Libya. Bourdain looks at the country through personal stories, food, and the music of anti-Qaddafi rapper expats.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony dives into the state of Punjab, India, starting off in Amritsar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
